description: This file defines the EntityJoinOperator class, which represents join operators (AND/OR) used to combine entity conditions in query formation, including methods for building SQL strings, evaluating conditions, and ensuring consistency.

classes.name: EntityJoinOperator
classes.description: Represents a join operator (AND/OR) for combining multiple entity conditions with support for SQL generation, evaluation, and validation.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Constructs the SQL string for the join operator with provided entity conditions, handling proper syntax and parentheses.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Creates frozen (immutable) copies of entity conditions for safe reuse or comparison.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Evaluates whether an entity matches the combined conditions based on the join logic.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Evaluates whether a map (e.g., query parameters) matches the combined conditions using delegation.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Validates the entity conditions against the model to ensure correctness of SQL generation.
